findings.message: <div id="flow-1"> has timing attributes but no class="clip". The runtime still hides it outside its time range, but Studio and the GSAP clip-ownership rules use .clip to recognise a clip, so leaving it off makes the element harder to edit and to lint.
findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.

findings.message: <div id="open-tagline"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="open-tagline"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: <audio id="main-mix"> runs from 0s to 74s, past the root composition's data-duration of 70s, so it is cut off in previews, posters and renders.
findings.fixHint: Extend the root data-duration to 74, or make <audio id="main-mix"> end at or before 70s.

findings.message: Multiple root-level HTML files with data-composition-id: index.html, short.html. The runtime may discover both as entry points, causing duplicate audio playback.
findings.fixHint: A project should have exactly one root index.html with data-composition-id. Remove or rename extra files.
